input.summary: Add Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity with procedure and remedies; narrow Customer's indemnity
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 20 currently contains only an unbounded Customer indemnity for "every claim" and no Vendor indemnity, so we have added Vendor's defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, Vendor-caused data breach and wilful misconduct, together with the standard notice/control procedure and the infringement remedies that Section 9.3 already cross-references. We have also narrowed our indemnity to Customer-provided content and our own breach of law, consistent with our playbook position.

ops.oldText: Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.
ops.newText: Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from third-party claims, and resulting damages, costs, and expenses, to the extent arising out of content or materials Customer provides to Vendor for use in the Services or Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

ops.text: Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services, Deliverables, or Vendor Technology infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of a claim, and the indemnifying Party shall control the defence with counsel reasonably acceptable to the indemnified Party, provided that it may not settle a claim in a manner that imposes a non-monetary obligation on, or admits liability of, the indemnified Party without prior written consent. The indemnified Party may participate with its own counsel at its own expense and shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense. Delay in notice reduces the indemnity only to the extent of resulting prejudice.

Vendor's indemnity in Section 20.2(a) does not apply to the extent an infringement claim arises from Customer's modification of the Services or Deliverables without Vendor's authorization, combination of the Services or Deliverables with items not supplied or recommended by Vendor where the claim would have been avoided absent the combination, or Vendor's compliance with Customer's written specifications.

If an infringement claim is made or Vendor reasonably believes one is likely, Vendor shall at its expense procure the right for Customer to continue using the affected item, or modify or replace it with a functionally equivalent non-infringing item. If neither remedy is reasonably available, Customer may terminate the affected Services or Deliverables and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees allocable to the terminated items and Fees paid for Deliverables Customer can no longer use.
